description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to process containers within the WPEFramework, including iterators for network interfaces, memory info, processor info, container instances, and the container administrator. It provides abstractions for managing and querying container properties such as memory, CPU, network interfaces, container lifecycle (start/stop), and container enumeration.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator for network interfaces, providing methods to retrieve the name, number of addresses, and specific IP addresses associated with a network interface.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface for obtaining memory usage statistics of a container: allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface to retrieve CPU usage information, including total usage, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a container with methods to get its ID, PID, memory and CPU info, network interfaces, container state, and control methods to start and stop the container.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator for enumerating containers, providing access to container IDs.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance given an ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator of all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, returning nullptr if not found.
